h1.en: Humira vs Enbrel vs Rinvoq: Rheumatoid Arthritis Medication Cost Comparison for 2026
h1.es: Humira vs Enbrel vs Rinvoq: Comparacion de Costo de Medicamentos para Artritis Reumatoide en 2026

subhero.en: Humira (adalimumab), Enbrel (etanercept), and Rinvoq (upadacitinib) are three of the most-prescribed rheumatoid arthritis medications in the United States, and their 2026 costs differ by more than 15-fold depending on which biosimilar or Medicare pathway you use. Humira now competes against more than ten FDA-approved biosimilars, with the unbranded version running about $550 per month cash price. Enbrel carries a Medicare Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 per month under the Inflation Reduction Act, down 67% from its $7,106 list price, effective January 1, 2026. Rinvoq, a JAK inhibitor with no generic or biosimilar competition until at least 2037, still costs $6,245 to $9,104 per month without insurance. This comparison breaks down cash pricing by pharmacy, Medicare Part D and Medicaid treatment, each manufacturer's patient assistance program, and the FDA safety rule that often forces patients to fail a TNF inhibitor before insurance will cover Rinvoq.
subhero.es: Humira (adalimumab), Enbrel (etanercept) y Rinvoq (upadacitinib) son tres de los medicamentos mas recetados para la artritis reumatoide en Estados Unidos, y sus costos de 2026 difieren en mas de 15 veces segun el biosimilar o la via de Medicare que use. Humira ahora compite con mas de diez biosimilares aprobados por la FDA, con la version sin marca costando aproximadamente $550 por mes en efectivo. Enbrel tiene un Precio Maximo Justo de Medicare de $2,355 por mes bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, una reduccion del 67% desde su precio de lista de $7,106, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026. Rinvoq, un inhibidor de JAK sin competencia generica o biosimilar hasta al menos 2037, todavia cuesta $6,245 a $9,104 por mes sin seguro.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, Humira costs $550 to $6,922 per month depending on whether you use an unbranded biosimilar or the brand, Enbrel costs $2,355 per month for Medicare Part D enrollees under its IRA-negotiated Maximum Fair Price (versus $6,800 to $7,500 cash price without insurance), and Rinvoq costs $6,245 to $9,104 per month with no generic or biosimilar available until an expected 2037 patent settlement date. Only Enbrel was selected for Round 1 Inflation Reduction Act negotiation; Humira and Rinvoq are not IRA-negotiated. AbbVie's myAbbVie Assist program covers both Humira and Rinvoq for uninsured patients at or below 600% of the Federal Poverty Level, though Humira is being phased out of that program for new applicants starting July 1, 2026 because biosimilars now exist. Amgen's Safety Net Foundation offers free Enbrel to uninsured patients meeting separate income criteria. Because Rinvoq carries an FDA boxed warning restricting its use to patients who already tried and failed a TNF inhibitor like Humira or Enbrel, most insurers require documented step therapy before covering it, which shapes both the clinical and cost pathway for new RA patients.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, Humira cuesta $550 a $6,922 por mes segun use un biosimilar sin marca o la marca, Enbrel cuesta $2,355 por mes para los inscritos en Medicare Parte D bajo su Precio Maximo Justo negociado por la IRA (frente a $6,800 a $7,500 en efectivo sin seguro), y Rinvoq cuesta $6,245 a $9,104 por mes sin generico ni biosimilar disponible hasta una fecha esperada de acuerdo de patente en 2037. Solo Enbrel fue seleccionado para la negociacion de la Ronda 1 de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion; Humira y Rinvoq no estan negociados por la IRA. El programa myAbbVie Assist de AbbVie cubre tanto Humira como Rinvoq para pacientes sin seguro con ingresos al o por debajo del 600% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, aunque Humira se esta eliminando de ese programa para nuevos solicitantes a partir del 1 de julio de 2026 porque ahora existen biosimilares.

callout.en: Enbrel is the only one of these three RA drugs selected for Medicare's first round of Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation. Its Medicare Maximum Fair Price is $2,355 for a 30-day supply, a 67% reduction from the pre-negotiation list price of $7,106, effective January 1, 2026. Humira was not selected because it already faces biosimilar competition, and Rinvoq was not part of the first negotiation cycle at all. Medicare Part D enrollees taking Enbrel pay this negotiated rate at any network pharmacy; enrollees taking Humira or Rinvoq instead rely on their plan's formulary tier, manufacturer patient assistance, or biosimilar substitution to control cost.
callout.es: Enbrel es el unico de estos tres medicamentos para AR seleccionado para la primera ronda de negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. Su Precio Maximo Justo de Medicare es $2,355 por un suministro de 30 dias, una reduccion del 67% desde el precio de lista previo a la negociacion de $7,106, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026. Humira no fue seleccionado porque ya enfrenta competencia de biosimilares, y Rinvoq no formo parte del primer ciclo de negociacion en absoluto.

introParagraphs.en: Humira (adalimumab), Enbrel (etanercept), and Rinvoq (upadacitinib) are three of the most-prescribed disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs) for moderate to severe rheumatoid arthritis in the United States, and their 2026 costs diverge sharply for three separate reasons: biosimilar competition, Inflation Reduction Act negotiation status, and small-molecule patent protection. Humira and Enbrel are both large-molecule biologic TNF (tumor necrosis factor) inhibitors given by subcutaneous injection, while Rinvoq is a small-molecule oral JAK (Janus kinase) inhibitor taken as a once-daily tablet. That mechanism difference drives an important prescribing rule: the FDA requires most JAK inhibitors, including Rinvoq, to carry a boxed warning limiting their use to patients who have already tried and failed, or cannot tolerate, a TNF inhibitor like Humira or Enbrel. For single-drug detail beyond this comparison, see the dedicated pages for [Humira cost](/drug/humira-cost), [Enbrel cost](/drug/enbrel-cost), and [Rinvoq cost](/drug/rinvoq-cost).
introParagraphs.es: Humira (adalimumab), Enbrel (etanercept) y Rinvoq (upadacitinib) son tres de los farmacos antirreumaticos modificadores de la enfermedad (FAME) mas recetados para la artritis reumatoide moderada a severa en Estados Unidos, y sus costos de 2026 difieren notablemente por tres razones separadas: competencia de biosimilares, estado de negociacion de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, y proteccion de patente de molecula pequena. Humira y Enbrel son ambos biologicos inhibidores del TNF de molecula grande administrados por inyeccion subcutanea, mientras que Rinvoq es un inhibidor de JAK oral de molecula pequena tomado como una tableta una vez al dia. Esa diferencia de mecanismo impulsa una regla de prescripcion importante: la FDA requiere que la mayoria de los inhibidores de JAK, incluyendo Rinvoq, lleven una advertencia de recuadro negro que limita su uso a pacientes que ya intentaron y fallaron, o no toleran, un inhibidor del TNF como Humira o Enbrel.

introParagraphs.en: The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, signed August 16, 2022, authorized CMS to negotiate Medicare drug prices directly with manufacturers for the first time. Enbrel was one of the first 10 drugs selected for Round 1 negotiation, and its Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 per 30-day supply took effect January 1, 2026, a 67% cut from its $7,106 list price. Humira and Rinvoq were not selected for Round 1: Humira because biosimilar competitors already existed by the statutory selection date, and Rinvoq because CMS's initial 10-drug list focused on the highest Medicare Part D spend at the time of selection in 2023, before Rinvoq's spending had grown large enough to qualify. Neither exclusion means Humira or Rinvoq is cheap; it means their 2026 cost depends entirely on biosimilar competition (Humira) or manufacturer patient assistance and formulary placement (Rinvoq) rather than a federally negotiated price.
introParagraphs.es: La Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, firmada el 16 de agosto de 2022, autorizo a CMS a negociar directamente los precios de medicamentos de Medicare con los fabricantes por primera vez. Enbrel fue uno de los primeros 10 medicamentos seleccionados para la negociacion de la Ronda 1, y su Precio Maximo Justo de $2,355 por suministro de 30 dias entro en vigor el 1 de enero de 2026, una reduccion del 67% desde su precio de lista de $7,106. Humira y Rinvoq no fueron seleccionados para la Ronda 1: Humira porque ya existian biosimilares competidores para la fecha estatutaria de seleccion, y Rinvoq porque la lista inicial de 10 medicamentos de CMS se enfoco en el gasto mas alto de Medicare Parte D en el momento de la seleccion en 2023.

introParagraphs.en: Rheumatologists typically start newly diagnosed RA patients on methotrexate, a low-cost conventional DMARD running $10 to $30 per month generic, before escalating to a biologic or JAK inhibitor if disease activity remains high. Patients who need to escalate usually try Humira or Enbrel first, both because those two TNF inhibitors have decades of safety data and because most insurance formularies require documented TNF inhibitor failure before approving Rinvoq under the FDA's step-therapy-aligned labeling. Switching between these three drugs for cost reasons requires prescriber input, since Humira and Enbrel have different injection schedules (biweekly versus weekly) and Rinvoq carries its own cardiovascular and blood clot warnings that some patients cannot safely take regardless of price. The comparison table below lays out cash price, Medicare Part D treatment, biosimilar or generic status, and manufacturer patient assistance program for all three drugs side by side.
introParagraphs.es: Los reumatologos generalmente inician a los pacientes recien diagnosticados con AR en metotrexato, un FAME convencional de bajo costo que cuesta $10 a $30 por mes generico, antes de escalar a un biologico o inhibidor de JAK si la actividad de la enfermedad sigue siendo alta. Los pacientes que necesitan escalar generalmente prueban Humira o Enbrel primero, tanto porque esos dos inhibidores del TNF tienen decadas de datos de seguridad como porque la mayoria de los formularios de seguro requieren fallo documentado del inhibidor del TNF antes de aprobar Rinvoq bajo el etiquetado de la FDA alineado con la terapia escalonada.

paragraphs.en: Specialty pharmacies, not hospital pharmacies, dispense Humira, Enbrel, and Rinvoq in the vast majority of cases, because all three require cold-chain shipping (Humira and Enbrel) or specific handling protocols and prior authorization paperwork (all three) that standard retail pharmacy counters are not set up to process. When any of the three is instead administered or dispensed during an inpatient hospital stay, for example after a severe RA flare with another complicating diagnosis, Medicare bundles the cost into the Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) payment for that admission rather than billing it as a separate line item, and commercial insurers negotiate their own bundled inpatient rates separately from any retail price.
paragraphs.es: Las farmacias especializadas, no las farmacias hospitalarias, dispensan Humira, Enbrel y Rinvoq en la gran mayoria de los casos, porque los tres requieren envio en cadena de frio (Humira y Enbrel) o protocolos de manejo especificos y papeleo de autorizacion previa (los tres) que los mostradores de farmacia minorista estandar no estan preparados para procesar.

paragraphs.en: Rinvoq's inpatient facility rate runs highest of the three, up to $27,000 for a month-equivalent supply, because hospital pharmacies that do stock a small-molecule oral RA drug for an admitted patient typically mark up the per-tablet chargemaster rate well above the outpatient specialty pharmacy price, and few hospital formularies stock it in volume given how rarely it is used inpatient. Medicare Part A stops paying for any of the three drugs the moment a patient is discharged, and coverage shifts entirely to Part D for the outpatient prescription, which is where Enbrel's 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 per month kicks in.
paragraphs.es: La tarifa de instalacion para pacientes internados de Rinvoq es la mas alta de los tres, hasta $27,000 por un suministro equivalente a un mes, porque las farmacias hospitalarias que si tienen en existencia un medicamento oral de molecula pequena para AR para un paciente internado tipicamente aumentan la tarifa por tableta muy por encima del precio de la farmacia especializada ambulatoria.

paragraphs.en: Methotrexate, the decades-old generic conventional DMARD, remains the lowest-cost fallback across all three biologic and JAK inhibitor scenarios at roughly $10 to $30 per month, but it works more slowly and less powerfully for moderate to severe RA than any of the three drugs compared here. Patients who cannot afford Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq should ask their rheumatologist whether a biosimilar switch, methotrexate combination therapy, or a manufacturer patient assistance program is clinically appropriate rather than skipping doses, since uncontrolled RA can cause permanent joint damage.
paragraphs.es: El metotrexato, el FAME convencional generico de decadas de antiguedad, sigue siendo la alternativa de menor costo en los tres escenarios de biologicos e inhibidores de JAK a aproximadamente $10 a $30 por mes, pero actua mas lento y con menos fuerza para la AR moderada a severa que cualquiera de los tres medicamentos comparados aqui.

intro.en: Humira and Enbrel each carry a HCPCS Level II J-code, used when a clinic or infusion suite administers or bills the drug directly rather than a patient self-injecting a take-home prescription billed through Part D. Rinvoq is an oral tablet with no J-code because it is never administered by a clinician.
intro.es: Humira y Enbrel tienen cada uno un codigo J de HCPCS Nivel II, usado cuando una clinica o sala de infusion administra o factura el medicamento directamente en lugar de que el paciente se autoinyecte una receta para llevar a casa facturada a traves de la Parte D. Rinvoq es una tableta oral sin codigo J porque nunca es administrado por un clinico.

description.en: Injection, adalimumab, 1 mg (covers brand Humira and all FDA-approved adalimumab biosimilars; replaced the discontinued 20mg-unit code J0135 effective January 1, 2025)
description.es: Inyeccion, adalimumab, 1 mg (cubre Humira de marca y todos los biosimilares de adalimumab aprobados por la FDA; reemplazo el codigo descontinuado J0135 de 20mg efectivo el 1 de enero de 2025)

whatToLookFor.en: Confirm the number of 1mg units billed matches your actual dose (standard adult RA dosing is 40mg biweekly, or 40 units, not 2); this single code now applies to brand Humira and every adalimumab biosimilar, so ask the billing office which specific product was dispensed
whatToLookFor.es: Confirme que el numero de unidades de 1mg facturadas coincide con su dosis real (la dosificacion estandar para adultos con AR es 40mg cada dos semanas, o 40 unidades, no 2); este codigo unico ahora aplica a Humira de marca y a todos los biosimilares de adalimumab

whatToLookFor.en: Standard adult RA dosing is 50mg weekly, or 2 units per week; check that this code was not billed for a dose you actually self-administered at home under Part D
whatToLookFor.es: La dosificacion estandar para adultos con AR es 50mg semanales, o 2 unidades por semana; verifique que este codigo no se facturo por una dosis que usted se autoadministro en casa bajo la Parte D

footnote.en: These J-codes appear on Medicare Part B claims only when a provider's office or infusion center administers the dose, which is uncommon for these three RA drugs since nearly all patients self-inject or self-administer at home under Part D. If you see one of these codes on a bill for a dose you gave yourself, ask your provider's billing office to correct the claim.
footnote.es: Estos codigos J aparecen en reclamos de Medicare Parte B solo cuando el consultorio de un proveedor o centro de infusion administra la dosis, lo cual es poco comun para estos tres medicamentos para AR ya que casi todos los pacientes se autoinyectan en casa bajo la Parte D.

note.en: Humira has the most mature biosimilar market of the three, with more than 10 FDA-approved adalimumab biosimilars and 7 holding the FDA's interchangeable designation as of 2026, which allows pharmacy-level substitution without a new prescription in most states. Enbrel has two FDA-approved biosimilars, Erelzi and Eticovo, but a patent litigation settlement between Amgen and each biosimilar maker keeps both off US shelves until 2029, so Enbrel patients cannot yet access a lower-cost biosimilar. Rinvoq is a small-molecule drug, not a biologic, so it will eventually receive a generic rather than a biosimilar; AbbVie settled patent litigation with generic manufacturers in September 2025, pushing expected generic upadacitinib entry to approximately April 2037. Until then, Rinvoq has no lower-cost equivalent and patients seeking savings must rely on the myAbbVie Assist patient assistance program or a switch back to a TNF inhibitor.
note.es: Humira tiene el mercado de biosimilares mas maduro de los tres, con mas de 10 biosimilares de adalimumab aprobados por la FDA y 7 con la designacion de intercambiable de la FDA a partir de 2026, lo que permite la sustitucion a nivel de farmacia sin una nueva receta en la mayoria de los estados. Enbrel tiene dos biosimilares aprobados por la FDA, Erelzi y Eticovo, pero un acuerdo de litigio de patente entre Amgen y cada fabricante de biosimilares los mantiene fuera de los estantes de EE.UU. hasta 2029. Rinvoq es un medicamento de molecula pequena, no un biologico, por lo que eventualmente recibira un generico en lugar de un biosimilar; AbbVie resolvio el litigio de patente con fabricantes genericos en septiembre de 2025, retrasando la entrada generica esperada de upadacitinib hasta aproximadamente abril de 2037.

howToApplyPap.programName: myAbbVie Assist (Humira and Rinvoq) and Amgen Safety Net Foundation (Enbrel)

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Visit abbvieaccess.com/patient-assistance (for Humira or Rinvoq) or amgensafetynetfoundation.com (for Enbrel), or call 1-800-222-6885 (AbbVie) or check the Amgen Safety Net Foundation site for its number, to confirm eligibility for your specific drug. If you have Medicare, apply for Part D Extra Help first at 1-800-772-1213.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Visite abbvieaccess.com/patient-assistance (para Humira o Rinvoq) o amgensafetynetfoundation.com (para Enbrel) para confirmar la elegibilidad de su medicamento especifico. Si tiene Medicare, solicite primero la Ayuda Adicional de la Parte D al 1-800-772-1213.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Download the patient application form from the manufacturer's website. Complete the patient section (name, address, household income, household size, insurance status) and have your rheumatologist complete and sign the prescriber section confirming your RA diagnosis and prescription.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Descargue el formulario de solicitud del paciente desde el sitio web del fabricante. Complete la seccion del paciente y haga que su reumatologo complete y firme la seccion del prescriptor confirmando su diagnostico de AR y receta.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather required documents: most recent federal tax return or 3 to 4 consecutive pay stubs showing household income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription for the specific drug, and documentation showing no current prescription drug insurance covering that drug.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Reuna los documentos requeridos: declaracion de impuestos federal mas reciente o 3 a 4 recibos de pago consecutivos que muestren ingresos familiares, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene seguro de medicamentos con receta para ese medicamento.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Submit the completed application and documents to the manufacturer's program by fax, mail, or online portal as listed on their website. Processing typically takes 7 to 15 business days depending on the manufacturer.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Envie la solicitud completa y los documentos al programa del fabricante por fax, correo o portal en linea segun se indica en su sitio web. El procesamiento generalmente toma 7 a 15 dias habiles.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: If approved, the manufacturer ships the medication directly to your home or your prescriber's office at no charge. Enrollment is generally valid for 12 months; annual re-enrollment requires resubmitting income documentation and a new prescriber signature. Humira applicants should note that new enrollment closes July 1, 2026, so apply for a biosimilar's own patient support program instead if you missed that window.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Si es aprobado, el fabricante envia el medicamento directamente a su domicilio o al consultorio de su prescriptor sin cargo. La inscripcion generalmente es valida por 12 meses; la reinscripcion anual requiere volver a presentar documentacion de ingresos. Los solicitantes de Humira deben tener en cuenta que la nueva inscripcion cierra el 1 de julio de 2026.

paragraphs.en: Medicare Part D treats these three RA drugs very differently in 2026. Enbrel is subject to the IRA Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 per month, applied at any network pharmacy regardless of which specific plan you carry. Humira and Rinvoq have no negotiated price; your out-of-pocket cost depends entirely on your Part D plan's formulary tier, and most plans place an interchangeable Humira biosimilar on a lower tier with a smaller copay than brand Humira. All out-of-pocket spending on any of the three drugs counts toward the same 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100; once you hit that cap across all your Part D drugs combined, you pay $0 for the rest of the calendar year.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Parte D trata a estos tres medicamentos para AR de manera muy diferente en 2026. Enbrel esta sujeto al Precio Maximo Justo IRA de $2,355 por mes, aplicado en cualquier farmacia de la red sin importar el plan especifico que tenga. Humira y Rinvoq no tienen un precio negociado; su costo de bolsillo depende completamente del nivel de formulario de su plan Parte D.

paragraphs.en: Extra Help, the Part D Low Income Subsidy, reduces cost-sharing further for Medicare beneficiaries with limited income and resources. In 2026, Extra Help enrollees pay $12.65 per fill for a brand-name drug like brand Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq, and a smaller copay for an interchangeable Humira biosimilar. Extra Help is generally available to beneficiaries with income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level. Apply through the Social Security Administration at 1-800-772-1213 or at ssa.gov, and mention which specific RA drug you take since eligibility rules for the manufacturer PAP on top of Extra Help vary by drug.
paragraphs.es: Extra Help, el Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos de la Parte D, reduce aun mas el costo compartido para los beneficiarios de Medicare con ingresos y recursos limitados. En 2026, los inscritos en Extra Help pagan $12.65 por reposicion para un medicamento de marca como Humira de marca, Enbrel o Rinvoq, y un copago menor para un biosimilar intercambiable de Humira.

intro.en: Watch for these RA-specific billing issues across Humira, Enbrel, and Rinvoq claims:
intro.es: Este atento a estos problemas de facturacion especificos de AR en reclamos de Humira, Enbrel y Rinvoq:

items.en: Specialty pharmacy or plan charges more than the $2,355 Enbrel IRA Maximum Fair Price for a Medicare Part D 30-day fill in 2026, which violates federal law; ask your plan's member services to reprocess the claim.
items.es: La farmacia especializada o el plan cobra mas del Precio Maximo Justo IRA de $2,355 para Enbrel en una reposicion de Medicare Parte D en 2026, lo que viola la ley federal.

items.en: A pharmacy substitutes an interchangeable Humira biosimilar without notifying you, which is legal in most states but should still appear correctly on your bill and formulary tier.
items.es: Una farmacia sustituye un biosimilar intercambiable de Humira sin notificarle, lo cual es legal en la mayoria de los estados pero debe aparecer correctamente en su factura.

items.en: Manufacturer copay card (HUMIRA Complete, the Enbrel Co-Pay Program, or RINVOQ Complete) applied to a patient enrolled in Medicare or Medicaid, which is prohibited and can trigger a claim clawback later.
items.es: Tarjeta de copago del fabricante aplicada a un paciente inscrito en Medicare o Medicaid, lo cual esta prohibido y puede resultar en una recuperacion del reclamo.

items.en: Rinvoq prior authorization denied without your rheumatologist documenting the FDA-required prior TNF inhibitor trial or intolerance; this is a paperwork fix, not a true coverage denial.
items.es: Autorizacion previa de Rinvoq denegada sin que su reumatologo documente el ensayo previo requerido por la FDA de un inhibidor del TNF; esto es un problema de papeleo, no una denegacion real de cobertura.

items.en: J1438 (Enbrel) or J0139 (Humira or an adalimumab biosimilar) billed under Part B for a dose you actually self-administered at home, which should instead be billed under Part D.
items.es: J1438 (Enbrel) o J0139 (Humira o un biosimilar de adalimumab) facturado bajo la Parte B por una dosis que usted realmente se autoadministro en casa, la cual deberia facturarse bajo la Parte D.

items.en: Charged the standard formulary copay after you already reached the 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100 across all your combined Part D drugs.
items.es: Se le cobro el copago estandar del formulario despues de que ya alcanzo el limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de $2,100 para 2026.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice from your insurer or Part D plan. Federal law requires written notice within 72 hours for standard decisions, or 24 hours for expedited requests, stating the specific reason for denial and your appeal rights.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito de su aseguradora o plan Parte D. La ley federal requiere aviso escrito dentro de las 72 horas para decisiones estandar, o 24 horas para solicitudes urgentes.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal appeal within 60 days of the written denial. Include a rheumatologist letter documenting your RA disease activity, prior treatment history, and why the requested drug is medically necessary.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias del aviso de denegacion por escrito. Incluya una carta del reumatologo que documente la actividad de su enfermedad y el historial de tratamiento previo.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: Ask your rheumatologist to request a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director, especially for a Rinvoq denial, documenting the specific TNF inhibitor trial, failure, or intolerance the FDA label requires.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Solicite a su reumatologo que pida una revision medico a medico con el director medico del plan, especialmente para una denegacion de Rinvoq, documentando el ensayo especifico del inhibidor del TNF.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the internal appeal is denied, escalate to an Independent Review Entity for Medicare Part D plans at 1-800-633-4227, or to your state Department of Insurance for commercial plans. Medicare beneficiaries can also contact their State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for free counseling.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si la apelacion interna es denegada, escale a una Entidad de Revision Independiente para planes Medicare Parte D al 1-800-633-4227, o al Departamento de Seguros de su estado.

stepTherapyOverride.en: Most plans require documented failure of, or intolerance to, a TNF inhibitor like Humira or Enbrel before covering Rinvoq, a rule that mirrors the FDA's own boxed warning restricting JAK inhibitor use in patients who have not already tried a TNF inhibitor. Your rheumatologist can file a step-therapy exception by documenting inadequate response, adverse events, or a contraindication to the required first-step drug, or by showing that requiring it would cause serious harm given active joint damage. Medicare and most state laws require plans to decide on a step-therapy exception within 72 hours of complete documentation, or 24 hours for urgent cases.
stepTherapyOverride.es: La mayoria de los planes requieren fallo documentado o intolerancia a un inhibidor del TNF como Humira o Enbrel antes de cubrir Rinvoq, una regla que refleja la propia advertencia de recuadro negro de la FDA que restringe el uso de inhibidores de JAK. Su reumatologo puede presentar una excepcion de terapia escalonada documentando respuesta inadecuada, eventos adversos o una contraindicacion al medicamento de primer paso requerido.

papFallback.en: If all insurance appeals fail, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug: myAbbVie Assist (abbvieaccess.com) for Humira, until it closes to new applicants July 1, 2026, or Rinvoq, which remains open, and the Amgen Safety Net Foundation for Enbrel. Each has a different FPL threshold, so check the one that applies to your prescribed drug before assuming you do not qualify.
papFallback.es: Si todas las apelaciones de seguro fallan, solicite el PAP del fabricante que corresponde a su medicamento especifico: myAbbVie Assist (abbvieaccess.com) para Humira, hasta que cierre a nuevos solicitantes el 1 de julio de 2026, o Rinvoq, que permanece abierto, y la Amgen Safety Net Foundation para Enbrel.

genericAlternative.en: Interchangeable Humira biosimilars (Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hyrimoz, Hulio, Simlandi, Yuflyma, Abrilada) are the most complete lower-cost alternative among the three, with the unbranded version running about $550 per month. Enbrel's approved biosimilars, Erelzi and Eticovo, remain blocked from the US market until 2029 due to patent litigation. No lower-cost alternative exists for Rinvoq until its expected 2037 generic entry. Methotrexate, a generic conventional DMARD at $10 to $30 per month, is the lowest-cost formulary alternative across all three but works more slowly and is not clinically interchangeable for every patient. Discuss any substitution with your rheumatologist before switching.
genericAlternative.es: Los biosimilares intercambiables de Humira (Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hyrimoz, Hulio, Simlandi, Yuflyma, Abrilada) son la alternativa de menor costo mas completa entre los tres, con la version sin marca costando aproximadamente $550 por mes. Los biosimilares aprobados de Enbrel, Erelzi y Eticovo, permanecen bloqueados del mercado de EE.UU. hasta 2029 debido a litigio de patente.

en.question: Is there a generic or biosimilar for Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq?
en.answer: Yes for two of the three. Humira has more than 10 FDA-approved biosimilars, with 7 holding interchangeable status as of 2026, and the unbranded version costs about $550 per month. Enbrel has two approved biosimilars, Erelzi and Eticovo, but a patent settlement blocks both from the US market until 2029. Rinvoq is a small-molecule drug with no biosimilar pathway; a generic is not expected until around April 2037 following a September 2025 patent settlement.

en.question: How do I apply for the Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq patient assistance program?
en.answer: Apply to the manufacturer of your specific drug: myAbbVie Assist at abbvieaccess.com for Humira (new applications close July 1, 2026) or Rinvoq (remains open), or the Amgen Safety Net Foundation at amgensafetynetfoundation.com for Enbrel. Each requires proof of income, US residency, a valid prescription, and documentation of no prescription drug coverage. Processing takes 7 to 15 business days, and approved enrollment typically lasts 12 months with annual re-verification.

en.question: Can I use a Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq savings card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law, 42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b, bars Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and VA beneficiaries from using any manufacturer copay savings card, including HUMIRA Complete, the Enbrel Co-Pay Program, and RINVOQ Complete. Medicare Part D patients on Enbrel should instead rely on the 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price of $2,355, and Humira or Rinvoq patients should apply for Part D Extra Help or the matching manufacturer PAP if they cannot afford the formulary copay.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq, or requires step therapy?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice, then file a formal appeal within 60 days with a rheumatologist letter documenting medical necessity. Rinvoq denials often require documenting a prior TNF inhibitor trial or intolerance, matching the FDA's own boxed warning restriction. If your plan requires step therapy, your rheumatologist can file a step-therapy exception documenting inadequate response, adverse events, or contraindication. If the appeal fails, apply for the manufacturer PAP that matches your specific drug.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated price apply to Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq?
en.answer: It applies only to Enbrel. Enbrel was selected for Medicare's first round of Inflation Reduction Act negotiation, with a Maximum Fair Price of $2,355 per month, effective January 1, 2026, a 67% reduction from its $7,106 list price. Humira was excluded because biosimilar competition already existed, and Rinvoq was not part of the initial 10-drug negotiation list. Out-of-pocket spending on all three still counts toward the 2026 Part D annual cap of $2,100.

en.question: What does each RA drug cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance, brand Humira runs $6,380 to $6,922 per month, brand Enbrel runs $6,800 to $7,500 per month, and brand Rinvoq runs $6,245 to $9,104 per month. With a biosimilar or GoodRx coupon, the unbranded Humira biosimilar drops to about $550 per month, Enbrel drops to about $3,354 per month with the best GoodRx coupon, and Rinvoq, which has no biosimilar, stays at its lowest cash price of about $6,245 per month.

en.question: Do I qualify for a patient assistance program based on my income?
en.answer: It depends on which drug you take. myAbbVie Assist, covering Humira and Rinvoq, generally requires household income at or below 600% of the Federal Poverty Level, or $95,760 for one person in 2026. The Amgen Safety Net Foundation for Enbrel uses a stricter threshold of roughly 400% FPL. Check the specific program for your prescribed drug, and note that Humira's program stops accepting new applicants July 1, 2026.

en.question: Which is cheaper: Humira, Enbrel, or Rinvoq, and why does a TNF inhibitor versus JAK inhibitor matter for cost?
en.answer: For uninsured patients without a PAP, an interchangeable Humira biosimilar is by far the cheapest at about $550 per month, since it is the only one of the three with a mature, competitive biosimilar market. Enbrel is often cheapest for Medicare Part D patients because of its 2026 IRA Maximum Fair Price of $2,355. Rinvoq stays the most expensive of the three because it has no generic or biosimilar competition, and its class-wide FDA boxed warning means most insurers require you to fail a TNF inhibitor like Humira or Enbrel first, which also delays access to it.

es.question: ¿Hay un generico o biosimilar para Humira, Enbrel o Rinvoq?
es.answer: Si para dos de los tres. Humira tiene mas de 10 biosimilares aprobados por la FDA, con 7 con estado intercambiable a partir de 2026, y la version sin marca cuesta aproximadamente $550 por mes. Enbrel tiene dos biosimilares aprobados, Erelzi y Eticovo, pero un acuerdo de patente bloquea a ambos del mercado de EE.UU. hasta 2029. Rinvoq es un medicamento de molecula pequena sin via de biosimilar; no se espera un generico hasta aproximadamente abril de 2037.

es.question: ¿Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente de Humira, Enbrel o Rinvoq?
es.answer: Solicite al fabricante de su medicamento especifico: myAbbVie Assist en abbvieaccess.com para Humira (las nuevas solicitudes cierran el 1 de julio de 2026) o Rinvoq (permanece abierto), o la Amgen Safety Net Foundation en amgensafetynetfoundation.com para Enbrel. Cada uno requiere comprobante de ingresos, residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y documentacion de que no tiene cobertura de medicamentos con receta.

es.question: ¿Puedo usar una tarjeta de ahorro de Humira, Enbrel o Rinvoq con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno, 42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b, prohibe a los beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE y VA usar cualquier tarjeta de ahorro de copago del fabricante, incluyendo HUMIRA Complete, el Programa de Copago de Enbrel y RINVOQ Complete. Los pacientes de Medicare Parte D con Enbrel deben confiar en el Precio Maximo Justo IRA de 2026 de $2,355 en su lugar.

es.question: ¿Que hago si mi seguro deniega la cobertura de Humira, Enbrel o Rinvoq, o requiere terapia escalonada?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito, luego presente una apelacion formal dentro de los 60 dias con una carta del reumatologo que documente la necesidad medica. Las denegaciones de Rinvoq a menudo requieren documentar un ensayo previo de un inhibidor del TNF o intolerancia, reflejando la propia advertencia de recuadro negro de la FDA. Si su plan requiere terapia escalonada, su reumatologo puede presentar una excepcion.

es.question: ¿Aplica el precio negociado de la IRA a Humira, Enbrel o Rinvoq?
es.answer: Aplica solo a Enbrel. Enbrel fue seleccionado para la primera ronda de negociacion de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, con un Precio Maximo Justo de $2,355 por mes, efectivo el 1 de enero de 2026, una reduccion del 67% desde su precio de lista de $7,106. Humira fue excluido porque ya existia competencia de biosimilares, y Rinvoq no formo parte de la lista inicial de 10 medicamentos negociados.

es.question: ¿Cuanto cuesta cada medicamento para AR sin seguro en la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro, Humira de marca cuesta $6,380 a $6,922 por mes, Enbrel de marca cuesta $6,800 a $7,500 por mes, y Rinvoq de marca cuesta $6,245 a $9,104 por mes. Con un biosimilar o cupon de GoodRx, el biosimilar sin marca de Humira baja a aproximadamente $550 por mes, Enbrel baja a aproximadamente $3,354 por mes con el mejor cupon de GoodRx, y Rinvoq, que no tiene biosimilar, se mantiene en su precio en efectivo mas bajo de aproximadamente $6,245 por mes.

es.question: ¿Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente segun mis ingresos?
es.answer: Depende de que medicamento tome. myAbbVie Assist, que cubre Humira y Rinvoq, generalmente requiere ingresos familiares al o por debajo del 600% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, o $95,760 para una persona en 2026. La Amgen Safety Net Foundation para Enbrel usa un umbral mas estricto de aproximadamente 400% FPL. Verifique el programa especifico para su medicamento recetado, y tenga en cuenta que el programa de Humira deja de aceptar nuevos solicitantes el 1 de julio de 2026.

es.question: ¿Cual es mas barato: Humira, Enbrel o Rinvoq, y por que importa un inhibidor del TNF frente a un inhibidor de JAK para el costo?
es.answer: Para pacientes sin seguro y sin PAP, un biosimilar intercambiable de Humira es por mucho el mas barato a aproximadamente $550 por mes, ya que es el unico de los tres con un mercado de biosimilares maduro y competitivo. Enbrel suele ser el mas barato para pacientes de Medicare Parte D debido a su Precio Maximo Justo IRA de 2026 de $2,355. Rinvoq sigue siendo el mas caro de los tres porque no tiene competencia generica ni de biosimilares, y su advertencia de recuadro negro de toda la clase de la FDA significa que la mayoria de los aseguradores requieren que primero falle con un inhibidor del TNF como Humira o Enbrel.
